name: ai-marketplace
description: Sander's personal marketplace of reusable Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: dotnet-architecture
plugins.description: Clean .NET solution architecture: small per-responsibility projects, one-class-per-use-case handlers, thin controllers, attribute-based DI.

plugins.name: coolify
plugins.description: Manage self-hosted Coolify servers over SSH: application/container status, volumes, logs, and troubleshooting.

plugins.name: newrelic
plugins.description: Query and troubleshoot New Relic from the terminal: application logs and errors, NRQL through NerdGraph, APM and browser data, and agent setup checks.

plugins.name: demo
plugins.description: Demo reports for npm web projects: Playwright tests per acceptance criterion, videos, before/after screenshots, and an AC checklist page.
